contract_revision_reason: pre-final assay audit successively corrected conditional risk sets, non-contractual gating, support-tier training, control hard matching, spurious routes, weak ridge regularisation and an overly strict negative-interpretation gate; v9 added the missing B_history arm, and v10 retains the direct derived B_route_state-minus-B_history contrast so the recent-history question is answered without combining separately aggregated medians; no model, risk set, gate or primary estimand changes
scientific_question: Can a frozen interictal state add out-of-fold seizure-risk and seizure-entry information when different seizures from the same patient may use different state-space routes?

nonblocking_strata.all_frozen: primary development population; no H2b outcome selection
nonblocking_strata.collapsed_or_instrument_weak: retained as a named negative-control stratum rather than blocking execution
nonblocking_strata.preexisting_h1_stable: interpretation stratum fixed before H2b; never an execution gate

heterogeneous_route_model.route_feature_space: outer-training-only standardisation and PCA retaining 90 percent variance with at most four components
heterogeneous_route_model.route_definition: deterministic two-means on frozen state at prior seizure lead anchors
heterogeneous_route_model.route_state_features: fixed-width distances to at most two training route prototypes plus nearest-route distance
heterogeneous_route_model.heterogeneity_estimand: on folds with two TRAIN routes, held-out log_loss(two-route state) - log_loss(single TRAIN-defined directed slow axis)
heterogeneous_route_model.interpretation: negative supports a low-capacity multi-route readout; it does not establish distinct biological causes

hazard.initial_training_rule: for at least 10 supported seizures use the first floor(60 percent), minimum 2; for 5-9 use first 2 as rolling sensitivity; for 3-4 use first 2 as descriptive; fewer than 3 not estimable
hazard.primary_model: ridge conditional logistic regression on one case plus five deterministic outcome-blind controls per seizure
hazard.control_matching: same patient and valid recorded coverage; same coverage segment preferred but not required; complete seizure-free horizon; outcome-blind deterministic sampling independent of history, observation and state; history, segment and session position explicitly adjusted in every arm
hazard.outer_test_controls: strictly after the preceding seizure cutoff and no later than the held-out onset; disjoint from outer TRAIN rows

models.B_history: explicit IED history plus strictly causal seizure/session context
models.B_observation: history plus causal context plus current explicit observation plus training-seizure observation-route distances
models.B_linear_state: B_observation base plus raw frozen persistent state; descriptive direct linear comparator
models.B_single_axis_state: B_observation plus one signed TRAIN-defined persistent-state seizure-entry axis
models.B_route_state: B_observation plus at most two persistent-state route distances
models.B_route_wrong_time: the trained B_route_state probe scored after replacing only test state with matched wrong-time state

hazard.primary_estimand: held-out equal-seizure-weight 30-minute conditional risk-set log_loss(B_route_state) - log_loss(B_observation)

time_specificity.primary: matched wrong-time state from the same patient and coverage segment
time_specificity.null: coverage-segment-wise circular shifts of the frozen state
time_specificity.slow_state_caveat: small temporal offsets inside one autocorrelation basin are not required to degrade performance

geometry.metric: frozen IED-decoder output with outer-training-only projection
geometry.route_definition: joint endpoint-position and unit-entry-direction clustering from prior seizures only

semi_synthetic_assay.directional_recovery_gate: all registered persistent-world contrasts favourable in at least 70 percent of replicates, while null, observation-only and clock primary directional rates remain at most 65 percent and calibrated 5 percent false-positive rates remain at most 10 percent
semi_synthetic_assay.strict_single_replicate_power_tier: at least 80 percent below the independently calibrated null 5th percentile; reported but not required to interpret a concordant positive development direction
semi_synthetic_assay.negative_interpretation_rule: unless strict single-replicate power passes, a real null or adverse effect is not a biological negative

claim_ladder.two_route_beats_single_route: within-patient seizure-entry heterogeneity improves the low-capacity readout
forbidden: different routes prove different seizure causes
